turns.user: Let me give you some background first, because it has been a long week. On Monday I drove my daughter to her swimming lesson, then stopped for groceries at FreshFields Market, where the queue was enormous because only one till was open. On Tuesday the boiler broke, and the repair person could only come on Thursday, so we boiled kettles for the dishes. Wednesday was my mother's birthday; we had dinner at a small Italian place near the river and the tiramisu was excellent. My neighbour lent us a space heater, which was kind of him. Thursday the boiler was fixed, although the bill was higher than the quote, and I spent the evening arguing with the company on the phone about the call-out fee. Friday I worked late, then picked up a takeaway and fell asleep on the sofa halfway through a documentary about lighthouses. On Saturday we visited the farmers' market, bought far too many apples, and spent the afternoon making a crumble that nobody finished. Sunday was quiet: laundry, a long walk with the dog along the canal, and an attempt to organise the spare room that mostly involved finding old photographs and reading birthday cards from ten years ago. I also tried to sort out my budget for the next month, which is why I'm writing, but I got distracted by the photos again. My son wants a new bike for his birthday, my car needs new tyres before winter, and we're thinking about a short trip in the spring, so I want to keep an eye on spending.
